macros.name: tagmcbegin
macros.doc: These commands insert the begin of the marked content code in the PDF.

macros.name: tagmcuse
macros.doc: These commands allow you to record a marked content that you stashed away into the current structure.

macros.name: tagpdfsetup
macros.doc: This command sets up the general behavior of the package.

macros.name: tagstructbegin
macros.doc: These commands start a new structure.

macros.name: tagstructuse
macros.doc: These commands insert a structure previously stashed away as kid into the currently active structure.
